difficulty_reason: Compute A_n explicitly: decompose Y_n = X' amalga Z_n and R_n into four summands, identify A_n as the equalizer of A x O_X/I^n -> f_{n,*}O_{X' x_X Z_n}; the claim becomes: for n large the image of A_{n+m} -> A_n is O_X, checked etale-locally so X may be affine Noetherian. Kernel stabilization (ACC for coherent modules), I^t J = 0, J subset I^n for all n, then Artin-Rees gives J ∩ I^n ⊂ I^{n-c}J whence J = 0; finally the formal-functions ML bound Ker(B -> Gamma(f_*(O/I^{n+m+c}O))) ⊂ I^{n+m}B plus finiteness of R -> B gives I^{n+m}B ⊂ Im(I^n -> B) for m large, closing the inclusion chain as A ⊂ B.
